institutions.name: Teatrul Naţional Bucureşti
institutions.confirmed_2026_08_14: CLIENT-SIDE, proven both ways: curl of the page yields 0 occurrences of '2026-09', while the browser-rendered DOM (operator-supplied .mhtml) yields 60. So 'browser' is correct and Playwright is genuinely required here — the only venue of the 12 for which that is true. URL uses a BARE month (month=9, not 09), hence {M}.
institutions.extractor_notes: Renders with the FullCalendar library. Events carry NO date of their own — they are positioned by column under a <thead> of data-date cells, with empty leading cells collapsed into <td rowspan=5> spacers, so column index must track rowspan occupancy. data-date is also present on all ~42 cells including empty ones; reading it naively invents a show per calendar square. Verified 81 rows for September 2026 against a screenshot: 5 shows on 05.09, 4 on 06.09, matching exactly.
institutions.notes: Largest venue in the set; worth getting right.

institutions.name: Teatrul Bulandra
institutions.corrected_2026_08_14: WAS WRONG — pointed at the homepage, which serves stale April listings, so extraction returned 0 while the real page was full. /program/ is linked directly from the homepage HTML; the original discovery pass used a markdown renderer that silently dropped <a href> elements and I read that silence as 'no calendar page exists'. Lossy extraction is not evidence of absence. Discovery now reads raw HTML (see the `discover` stage).
institutions.notes: Programme page confirmed by the operator as covering ~5 Sept to 4 Oct. robots.txt blocks some automated fetchers; curl with a normal UA works.

institutions.name: Circul Metropolitan Bucureşti
institutions.verified_2026_08_14: bilete.circulmetropolitan.ro serves an EXPIRED TLS certificate (curl exit 60). Demoted from primary to last-resort alt. `insecure: true` is scoped to this institution only — it skips cert verification for these hosts and nothing else. Rows sourced here are flagged TLS UNVERIFIED in the output. Remove the flag once the venue renews its certificate.
institutions.notes: No dated calendar on the main site — only show portfolio. The dated schedule lives on the institution's own ticketing subdomain. This is the case that broke the original prompt's 'no ticket sites' rule.

institutions.name: Teatrul Masca
institutions.disabled_2026_08_14: Operator decision. /teatru/calendar/ IS the right page, but its markup does not yield dates to this pipeline (snapshot: 130 KB raw -> 1.4 KB text, 0 date matches). /teatru/spectacolele-stagiunii/ lists productions without dates, and individual show pages (/teatru/<slug>/) carry only duration plus outbound links to myStage and Bilet.ro — third-party ticket sites, which policy excludes. So no in-policy source exposes Masca's dates in parseable form. Kept in the registry (not deleted) so the completeness table still accounts for all 12 institutions; set enabled:true to reinstate.
institutions.notes: WordPress under /teatru/. Revisit if the venue republishes its calendar in a structured form.
